summary: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, reporting a board resolution to declare a quarterly cash dividend. The dividend is 830 won per common share, with a market dividend rate of 0.8%. The record date is May 31, 2026, and payment will occur on June 18, 2026. The total dividend payment amounts to approximately 176.8 billion won. This is a routine dividend declaration and does not qualify as a special situation. The filing is an ordinary distribution of earnings with no M&A or restructuring implications.
